releaseNotes: v1.10.60: Align /v1/images/edits with the OpenAI request contract. Unknown OpenAI fields (input_fidelity, output_format, output_compression, background, quality, user) are forwarded instead of dropped, the SDK image shapes (array, {image_url}, {url}) are accepted, file_id and mask references are refused with the upstream message, the forwarded request is presented as application/json, an oversized body answers 413 naming the limit, multipart dispatch is case-insensitive, a non-raster upload is refused instead of being coerced to image/png, and the image count is one number (16) enforced the same way in both lanes.
